name: 3D Widget Interaction Model
definition: 3D widgets are subclasses of vtkInteractorObserver, associated with a vtkRenderWindow and observing events. They differ from vtkInteractorStyle by having a representation in the scene that can be directly manipulated.
summary: The 3D Widget Interaction Model provides interactive scene objects that decouple user gestures from camera control, allowing direct manipulation of visualization parameters via an event-driven observer pattern.
